facts.fact_text: In 2009-14, the applicants lodged notices of LGBT public assemblies as indicated in the Appendix.
In each instance, the local authorities refused to approve the dates proposed by the applicants for the LGBT public assemblies.
In each instance, the local authorities refused to approve the locations proposed by the applicants for the LGBT public assemblies.
The relevant domestic law and practice is set out in Lashmankin and Others v. Russia, application nos. 57818/09 and 14 others, paragraphs 216-88, judgment of 7 February 2017.
The relevant international and comparative material is set out in Lashmankin and Others v. Russia, application nos. 57818/09 and 14 others, paragraphs 313-24, judgment of 7 February 2017.
The relevant domestic law and practice is also set out in Alekseyev v. Russia, application nos. 4916/07 and 2 others, paragraphs 49-52, judgment of 21 October 2010.
In every case, the judicial decisions were taken after the respective dates of the originally proposed assemblies.
The dates of the authorities' refusals are indicated in the Appendix.
The dates of the final domestic decisions are indicated in the Appendix.
The relevant domestic law and practice is set out in Lashmankin and Others v. Russia, application nos. 57818/09 and 14 others, paragraphs 216-88, judgment of 7 February 2017.
